# BillionVerify

> Validate email addresses in real-time or clean millions of records with the BillionVerify API, SDK docs, guides and market benchmark.

- Type: API and SDK documentation, guides and market benchmark for BillionVerify, an email verification service
- Free credits: 20 credits every day you use your account, up to 600 a month; they never expire; no credit card
- Billing: valid and invalid results use 1 credit each; unknown results cost nothing
- Last updated: 2026-10-31

Every page has a Markdown version: add .md to the path without the trailing slash. The home page is /index.md.

This site is in English only.

- [Docs](https://billionverify.github.io/docs/): API reference and SDK guides
- [Guides](https://billionverify.github.io/guides/): short summaries that link to the full articles on billionverify.com
- [Benchmark](https://billionverify.github.io/benchmark/): 19 email verification services compared
